_provenance.what: NMC's measured R = sigma_L/sigma_T at 0.0045 <= x <= 0.11 (ten x bins, one Q2-averaged value each) -- the reference side of the PRIMARY sub-row of validation/benchmarks/t1_r_world.py (run 2026-10-26 phase C1; docs/benchmarking/02_data_nucleon_deuteron.md sec. 4 R-3).

record.title: Measurement of the proton and deuteron structure functions, F2(p) and F2(d), and of the ratio sigma(L)/sigma(T).

_provenance.tables_not_used: Tables 1-32 (F2p, F2d averaged over the four energies): not R, not used. A fact recorded for the F2d row (t1_nmc_f2d.py reads Tables 17-32 through nnpdf-data): their independent variable SIG(L)/SIG(T) is the R NMC extracted F2 with -- in Tables 17-26 (x = 0.0045 ... 0.11) one value per table, equal to this table's R at the same x in all ten; in Tables 27-32 (x = 0.14 ... 0.5) Q2-dependent values (the paper's sec. 4: above x = 0.12 the R parametrisation of its ref. [2], R1990). Checked 2026-10-26 against the yaml downloads whose sha256 are in f2d_tables_checked.
_provenance.fetched: 2026-10-26 (UTC); the standard Python `requests` 2.25.1 client with its default identity (no header changed); curl's default identity receives HTTP 403 from www.hepdata.net and was not used
_provenance.licence: CC0-1.0: HEPData 'table_license' CC0 (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/), read from the table's json download; the numbers are measured quantities, vendored with attribution
_provenance.paper: M. Arneodo et al. (New Muon Collaboration), 'Measurement of the proton and deuteron structure functions, F2p and F2d, and of the ratio sigma_L/sigma_T', Nucl. Phys. B 483 (1997) 3, doi:10.1016/S0550-3213(96)00538-X, arXiv:hep-ph/9610231 (read: PolarizedLithiumSim/refs/hep-ph_9610231.pdf)
_provenance.publishing_convention: R = sigma_L/sigma_T is a RATIO: no per-nucleon / per-nucleus normalisation enters. It is 'the average R for the proton and the deuteron' (paper sec. 4: extracted from the combined proton and deuteron data, justified by NMC's R_d - R_p = 0 within 0.02 over 0.002 < x < 0.40); the record's reaction is 'MUON NUCLEON --> MUON X'. For x < 0.12 'one Q2 averaged value of R' per x bin (sec. 4), quoted at the mean Q2 of the bin (Table 7: '<Q2> is the mean value of Q2 at which R was determined'); the data 'do not allow a measurement of both its x and Q2 dependence' (sec. 4). At x = 0.0045 'the determination of R relies on the extrapolation of F2p and F2d from neighbouring bins at larger x' (sec. 4).
_provenance.errors: stat and sys given separately, symmetric, absolute. The systematic errors 'are 1.5 to 3 times larger than the statistical ones; they are dominated by the normalisation uncertainty and are thus largely correlated' (sec. 6); 'the uncertainties are largely correlated' (sec. 4.2); the statistical errors of neighbouring x bins are correlated by the F2 parametrisation (sec. 4.3). No covariance matrix is given in the paper or the record.
_provenance.cross_check: all ten rows (x, <Q2>, y range, R, stat, sys) equal the paper's Table 7 as printed (hep-ph/9610231 p. 14), checked number by number when this file was written
_provenance.in_r1998_fit: YES: Abe et al., PLB 452 (1999) 194 (hep-ex/9808028 p. 3): 'We have performed a new fit using the present data [3,11-14]' with [12] = 'NMC, M. Arneodo et al., Nucl. Phys. B483, 3 (1997)' -- this table is an input of the R1998 fit that lipolgen.r1998 transcribes.
_provenance.vendored_by: Written once on 2026-10-26 by a dev-time script kept outside the repository (the C1 worker's scratch directory): every number of `body` is copied from the table's YAML download (HEPData's submission format), whose sha256 is recorded per table under `tables_used`; nothing is rescaled, rounded or re-ordered beyond what `body` states.  The harness that reads this file re-checks the sha256 of every byte of it, and of the canonical body (json.dumps(body, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=True)) recorded as `_body_sha256`, on every read.
